items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: This guy who had the band... It was Charlie Creath; I think we had four pieces.

ctx.x: That was an after-hour place. This guy who had the band... It was Charlie Creath; I think we had four pieces. It was an after-hour place, that started... It started, I'd say, about ten o'clock at night, and it would go on until five or six the next morning. I made twenty-five dollars a week, and the tips was very good. You could come out of there sometimes with fifteen or twenty dollars a piece in tips. Sometimes I'd make around fifty or sixty dollars a week.
That was pretty good. Charlie Creath played what instrument?
